en.text: Labour Supply

zh.text: 勞力供應

en.text: Which of the following will increase the supply of labour?

zh.text: 下列哪項會增加勞力供應？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (4) only
(2) and (3) only
(3) and (4) only
The legal minimum working age is raised.

zh.text: 法定最低工作年齡提高。

en.text: The government introduces an unemployment benefit scheme.

zh.text: 政府引入失業救濟金計劃。

en.text: Workers are willing to work for longer hours at the same wage rate.

zh.text: 工人在同一工資率下願意工作更長時間。

en.text: The retirement age is raised.

zh.text: 退休年齡提高。

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1991 卷二 第 56 題

en.text: Which of the following factors would tend to increase the labor supply in Hong Kong?

zh.text: 以下哪種因素有可能使本港的勞力供應增加？

en.text: (1) and (3) only
(1) and (4) only
(2) and (3) only
(2) and (4) only
the government re-employs some retired civil servants.

zh.text: 政府再聘用一些已退休的公務員

en.text: There are more public holidays each year.

zh.text: 每年有更多公眾假期

en.text: There is a greater proportion of males in the population.

zh.text: 男性佔較高的人口比例

en.text: The educational level of workers becomes higher.

zh.text: 工人的教育水平提高

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1994 卷二 第 17 題

en.text: Which of the following will decrease the labor supply of a country?

zh.text: 下列哪一項會使一國的勞工供應減少？

en.text: fewer job vacancies

zh.text: 職位空缺減少。

en.text: more universities places for students

zh.text: 大學提供更多學位以供學生就讀。

en.text: an increase in the retirement age of workers

zh.text: 勞工的退休年齡提高了。

en.text: an increase in the number of immigrants

zh.text: 入口移民數目增加。

en.text: HKCEE 1996 Paper 2 Q12

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1996 卷二 第 12 題

en.text: Which of the following would increase the labour supply of Hong Kong?

zh.text: 下列哪一項會導致香港的勞力供應增加？

en.text: The demand for imported workers increases.

zh.text: 輸入勞工的需求增加。

en.text: All women are not allowed to work overtime.

zh.text: 全部婦女不准超時工作。

en.text: More employers provided child care services to their employees.

zh.text: 更多僱主提供幼兒托管服務予其僱員。

en.text: More job vacancies are available.

zh.text: 有更多職位空缺。

en.text: HKCEE 1998 Paper 2 Q15

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1998 卷二 第 15 題

en.text: Which of the following would increase the labour supply of Hong Kong?

zh.text: 下列哪一項會增加香港的勞工供應？

en.text: the provision of more day-time child-care services

zh.text: 提供更多日間託管兒服務。

en.text: a change in the payment system from piece rate to time rate

zh.text: 付酬方式由「件計」改為「時計」。

en.text: an increase in the number of public holidays in a year

zh.text: 增加每年公眾假期的日數。

en.text: a decrease in the number of people migrating to other countries

zh.text: 移民往外國的人數下降。

en.text: HKCEE 1999 Paper 2 Q14

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1999 卷二 第 14 題

en.text: Under which of the following situations would the labour supply in Hong Kong decrease?

zh.text: 在下列哪一種情況中，香港的勞力供應會減少？

en.text: All universities in Hong Kong admit fewer full time students.

zh.text: 所有香港的大學都減少招收全日制學生。

en.text: More Hong Kong companies provide training courses to their staff during office hours.

zh.text: 香港有更多公司在上班時間提供培訓課程予他們的員工。

en.text: Fewer Hong Kong people are allowed to emigrate to the US.

zh.text: 更少香港居民獲批准移民到美國。

en.text: The Hong Kong government provides subsidies to private firms for installing high-tech equipment.

zh.text: 香港政府提供津貼予私人機構安裝高科技儀器。

en.text: HKCEE 2001 Paper 2 Q13

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2001 卷二 第 13 題

en.text: The labour supply will increase if

zh.text: 在下列哪一種情況下，勞力供應會增加？

en.text: more job vacancies are available.

zh.text: 有更多職位空缺。

en.text: more universities offer 4-year degree courses instead of 3-year degree courses.

zh.text: 有更多大學提供四年大學學位課程，以代替三年大學學位課程。

en.text: the number of public holidays in a calendar year is reduced.

zh.text: 一年裏的公眾假期減少。

en.text: the retirement age is reduced.

zh.text: 退休年齡下降。

en.text: If the government raises the legal retirement age,

zh.text: 若政府提高法定退休年齡，

en.text: the occupational mobility of workers will increase.

zh.text: 工人的職業流動性會增加。

en.text: the average labour productivity will increase.

zh.text: 平均勞工生產力會增加。

zh.text: 勞力供應會增加。

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2009 卷二 第 16 題

en.text: Which of the following would decrease the labour supply of Hong Kong?

zh.text: 下列哪項會減少香港的勞力供應？

en.text: better and more job opportunities in mainland China

zh.text: 中國內地有更佳及更多就業機會。

en.text: the imposition of a minimum wage law for low-skilled workers in Hong Kong

zh.text: 香港實施低技術工人的最低工資法。

en.text: a lower average salaries tax rate in Hong Kong

zh.text: 香港薪俸稅的平均稅率下降。

en.text: an increase in the retirement age in Hong Kong

zh.text: 提高香港人的退休年齡。

en.text: HKCEE 2010 Paper 2 Q20

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2010 卷二 第 20 題

en.text: Which of the following policies will result in an increase in the labour force of Hong Kong?

zh.text: 下列哪項政策會令香港的勞動人口增加？

en.text: extension of free education from 9 years to 12 years

zh.text: 免費教育由九年延長至十二年

en.text: an increase in the minimum capital requirement of the Capital Investment Entrant Scheme (資本投資者入境計劃)

zh.text: 提高資本投資者入境計劃的最低資本要求

en.text: an increase in the immigration scheme quota for talented persons from the mainland

zh.text: 增加內地優才入境計劃的限額

en.text: introduction of maximum working hours

zh.text: 訂立最高工時

en.text: HKDSE 2012 Paper 1 Q6

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2012 卷一 第 6 題

en.text: Which of the following will increase the labour supply of an economy?

zh.text: 下列哪項會增加某經濟的勞力供應？

en.text: More firms allow male employees to take paternity leave.

zh.text: 更多廠商允許男性僱員請侍產假。

en.text: More companies offer free transport to employees working overtime.

zh.text: 更多公司為加班的僱員提供免費交通。

en.text: Universities provide more full-time associate degree programmes for secondary school graduates.

zh.text: 大學為中學畢業生開辦更多全日制副學士學位課程。

en.text: The government adopts maximum working hours for the civil servants.

zh.text: 政府對公務員實施最高工時。

en.text: HKDSE 2014 Paper 1 Q9

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2014 卷一 第 9 題

en.text: The labour supply of a country will increase if

zh.text: 在下列哪種情況下，某國的勞力供應會增加？

en.text: more training is provided for the existing labour force.

zh.text: 向現有的勞動人口提供更多訓練。

en.text: the legal minimum working age is lowered from 16 to 15.

zh.text: 法定最低的工作年齡由 16 歲降低至 15 歲。

en.text: foreign direct investment increases.

zh.text: 外國直接投資增加。

en.text: the government increases the salaries tax rate.

zh.text: 政府提高薪俸稅率。

en.text: HKDSE 2016 Paper 1 Q8

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2016 卷一 第 8 題

en.text: The labour supply in Hong Kong would increase if

zh.text: 若 ________，香港的勞力供應會增加。

en.text: more Hong Kong people migrated to foreign countries.

zh.text: 更多香港人移民外國

en.text: more Hong Kong students studied in tertiary institutions.

zh.text: 更多香港學生入讀大專院校

en.text: the Government lowered the qualification requirements for the Quality Migrant Admission Scheme.

zh.text: 政府降低「優才入境計劃」的資歷要求

en.text: all working fathers were allowed to take two extra days of paternity leave.

zh.text: 所有在職父親可多得兩天的侍產假
